map.液压阀功能选型 使用指南: Hydraulic Valve Function Selection User Guide
map.输入最大流量、工作压力、控制方式与阀门功能，计算阀通径并推荐合适的阀门类型与规格: Enter maximum flow, working pressure, control mode and valve function to compute the valve bore and recommend a suitable valve type and specification
map.按压差与阀口面积估算过阀流量。: Estimate the flow through a valve from the differential pressure and the orifice area.
map.节流调速的流量-压差关系。: The flow and pressure-differential relation for throttle control.
map.选阀通径满足最大流量压降。: Select a valve bore that satisfies the maximum flow pressure drop.
map.：Cd=1、A 对应 100 L/min 通径、Δp=5 bar、ρ=870 →: With Cd=1 and A corresponding to a 100 L/min bore, delta_p = 5 bar and rho = 870 -> Q is about Cd x A x sqrt(2x5e5/870); verify the flow at the rated pressure drop.
map.：Δp 翻倍流量仅增 41%（√Δp），节流调速非线性明显。: Doubling delta_p raises the flow only by 41% (sqrt of delta_p), so throttle control is clearly nonlinear.
map.孔口流量∝√Δp，调压即调流量，故节流调速有软特性。: Orifice flow is proportional to sqrt(delta_p), so regulating pressure regulates flow, which is why throttle control has soft characteristics.
map.通径怎么选？: How Do I Choose a Bore?
map.按额定流量下允许压降选，过大阀贵、过小压损高发热。: Choose by the allowable pressure drop at rated flow; too large a valve is expensive, too small gives high loss and heating.
